verdict: The funnel has never been meaningfully tested by humans. 229 of 294 recorded upgrade clicks (77.9%) carry a src that no live page emits and were produced by browser-UA automation, including this loop's own agents. Only 3 clicks (1.0%) came from an in-product free-tier cap message. Zero payments is the arithmetic of an empty room, not a conversion defect. The catalogued leaks are real and must be fixed before traffic arrives.

instrument.note: total_clicks == clicks_7d: every click ever recorded falls inside the instrument's own 7-day window.
instrument.delta: +141 clicks in ~17h on a site with 0 Google impressions and 22 unique human repo visitors in 14 days

free_tier_assessment.finding: The free tier is not too generous to be worth paying past; it is too generous to produce a purchase signal inside a trial. 3 invoices/month, 5 statements/month and 5 deposits/month bind in week three, not in the first session. Measured consequence: 3 in-product cap clicks in the instrument's lifetime.

top_three_fixes.title: Make the click counter countable
steps: Replace the start-anchored scripted test at :845 with one that also requires accept: text/html and sec-fetch-mode: navigate, which every real browser navigation sends and no curl -A sweep sends by default.
Never count a request whose resolved src is the ${id}.unknown fallback at :875; bucket it as unattributed:<id> outside total_clicks and clicks_7d.
Move recordClick above the 404 and PENDING_HUMAN returns at :848-856 with a distinct dead:<id> src so the 503/404 leak becomes measurable.
Reset the KV click: prefix once, and restate the KPI 'how' field in data/kpi.json to say what is then true.

top_three_fixes.title: Stop printing an install command that does not exist
steps: On home and /bundle, reorder 'Three ways to start' so connect-by-URL is first and npx is last.
Add to the npx bullet the sentence the /s/ pages already carry: npm publish is pending; use the .mcpb bundle or connect by URL until it lands.
In installSnippet() at :588-606, put /mcp/connect and the .mcpb download above the npx block.
top_three_fixes.verified_working_path: GET /mcp/connect -> 200, mints token; POST /mcp/invoice/t/<token> answered initialize (protocolVersion 2025-06-18, serverInfo mcp-invoice 0.20.0) and tools/list correctly during this audit

top_three_fixes.title: Make the free tier produce a purchase signal in the first session
top_three_fixes.owner: owner of the server packages (not agent A)
steps: Emit the tagged upgrade URL one step BEFORE the cap binds, not only at refusal: 'invoice 2 of 3 this month'.

Fix packages/mcp-license/src/index.ts:154 - LicenseGate.status() returns upgradeUrl without a src, so every click from license_status is filed as .unknown and mixed into crawler traffic. Give it ?src=<product>.license_status.

unmeasured.item: How many of the 294 clicks are human
unmeasured.why: The worker stores no IP, no UA and no timestamp beyond the day bucket alongside a click. Bounded above by 65 (the live-surface srcs). Not estimated.

unmeasured.item: How many clicks hit the 503 or 404 buy routes
unmeasured.why: Both branches return before recordClick (billing/src/index.js:848, :849-856). 33 dead links counted; zero clicks countable.

unmeasured.item: What the live Stripe hosted checkout page shows
unmeasured.why: checkout.stripe.com served a 564,105-byte JS shell with no product string, merchant name or price in the initial HTML. checkoutDescription() (billing/src/index.js:110-119) only feeds a stripe-sync step its own comment says is run by hand with a live key, and docs/LOOP29_BRIEF.md:21-23 records that the available key lacks product_write. Whether the live Stripe Products carry the right name and description is unverified by anyone.

No payment has been attempted. 27 of 31 routes reaching checkout.stripe.com proves a Session is created and nothing about the pay button, card acceptance or the webhook. /success and /recover have never run against a real payment.

unmeasured.item: Whether any of the 5,105 bundle downloads is a human install
unmeasured.why: Delegated to docs/AUDIENCE_REALITY_R1.md. Spot check of v0.19.0 agrees: 30 assets, mean 6.4, stdev 1.62, range 4-13; invoice.mcpb at 4 ties office-suite.mcpb, which is not a purchasable product. Flat where human demand is a power law.

unmeasured.item: Per-click timing, referrer or funnel joins
unmeasured.why: KV schema is click:<src>:<yyyy-mm-dd> and click:<src>:total (billing/src/index.js:508-509). No session, no referrer, no step data, so click->session->payment cannot be joined for any visitor.
